text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Yamanin Zephyr and I prepare for upcoming sprint and mile G1 races, we need to keep an eye out for two opponents in particular.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One is Daiichi Ruby, a runner from the most prestigious of families. She shoulders that glorious legacy and emits an intense aura of ambition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The other is Daitaku Helios, an astonishing front runner whose sheer speed seems to have no limit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having gotten a glimpse of the two towering obstacles she'll need to overcome, Zephyr begins to feel the pressure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Together, we set about devising a plan that will lead us to victory. And while formulating that plan, some breaking news rocks the racing world.
